name: @pipeworx/mcp-qrcode

tools.name: create_qr
tools.description: Generate a scannable QR code from text or URLs. Returns an image URL ready to embed or download. Use when you need to encode information into a QR code.

data.description: The text or URL to encode in the QR code.

size.description: Width and height of the QR code image in pixels (default 200).

tools.name: read_qr
tools.description: Decode QR code images to extract embedded text or URLs. Returns the decoded content. Use when you need to read what's stored in a QR code.

url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the QR code image to decode.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-qrcode forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the qrcode pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
